answer: Every identity on a jetty must be matched by an island that forfeits one sable of its own. The jetty records each island used; a new identity needs twice the number of fresh island forfeitures as the one before. The first costs one island and one sable, the tenth 512 of each, and the thousandth 2^999 of each. A second jetty inherits the first's forfeiture record, so splitting does not reset the bill.
